subject: Candidate Profile: Nick Giurleo
overview: Candidate Nick Giurleo outlines his professional background and platform for the Medford City Council, focusing on zoning policy and council procedural reforms.

items.title: Candidate Background
items.summary: Nick Giurleo introduces himself as a lifelong Medford resident and a practicing attorney with a focus on municipal law and land use.

items.title: Comprehensive Residential Rezoning
items.summary: Giurleo declares his opposition to the current comprehensive residential rezoning plan, citing concerns about neighborhood character, inadequate public notification, and a lack of economic and service impact studies.

items.title: Council Access and Procedural Reform
items.summary: The candidate proposes restoring public speaking time to five minutes, capping meeting lengths, and returning to weekly council meetings to improve public engagement.
